- The 9th action (MOUSE row=33, col=21) had 34 frames with 2273 cells changed - this was a massive board reorganization

Wait - maybe the issue is that I need to collect green blocks ONE AT A TIME and wait for the board to reorganize after each one, not batch them all together. Or maybe the game has a limit on how many blocks can be collected before something happens.
Actually, looking at Level 1's pattern:
1. I collected green blocks one at a time (or in small groups)
2. After collecting enough, the board reorganized
3. Then I navigated to the pink cross to complete the level

2. This causes green blocks to appear/change
